shots.action: Close on May, five, hopping onto the platform scale with a row of stamps on her coat (grinning, mouth open); the platform clunks, the needle behind her jumps; the clerk's hand comes in from the right with one more stamp
shots.camera: Eye level on her face, pushing in

shots.action: From behind and below her bobble hat, looking up at the big dial: the needle swings round, overshoots, wobbles and settles just under the red mark; she tips her head back to watch (eyes wide)
shots.camera: Low angle up at the dial, swinging round and rising

shots.action: Close on her coat: a hand presses one more stamp on beside the others and thumps it flat; she looks down at it and beams
shots.camera: Close, arcing in

shots.action: Rook is already there, leaning on the counter with his arms crossed and his hat brim low (unimpressed): 'You can't post a child.' He jerks his head at her on the last word; behind him she waves at him from the scale
shots.camera: Medium on Rook, the girl on the scale in frame behind him

shots.action: Her father counts coins out onto the counter one by one (head down), her mother beside him with her hands clasped (smiling); the clerk slides the stamps across
shots.camera: From the end of the counter, swinging round

shots.action: Low in front of May: she tugs her coat straight with both hands and lifts her chin, proud of her row of stamps (big smile)
shots.camera: Low and close, arcing and rising

shots.action: Rook by the window holds up a railway ticket in one hand and a stamp in the other, looks from one to the other (squinting), then lets the ticket drop and tips his brim
shots.camera: Medium close on Rook, arcing

shots.action: Rook's detective moment: up on his toes by the scale with his magnifying glass on the dial, reading the needle (squinting); May looks up at him (eyes wide)
shots.camera: From the front of the scale, arcing and closing in

shots.action: The whole post office: the girl bouncing on the scale, the clerk reading the dial and writing it down, her father with his hands on his hips, her mother watching
shots.camera: Wide, arcing across the room

shots.action: Very close on the dial: the needle trembles a hair under the red limit mark; a finger taps the mark twice
shots.camera: Close on the dial, arcing

shots.action: The mail train comes through the snowy hills towards us, smoke streaming back past the pines and telegraph poles
shots.camera: Wide, the camera dropping back and rising as the engine arrives

shots.action: Low beside the rails: the red driving wheels and the rod pounding round
shots.camera: Low tracking shot beside the wheels

shots.action: Inside the mail car: May sits on a mail sack swinging her legs (smiling), her little suitcase beside her; the clerk flicks letters into the case and glances round at her; daylight flashes in the open door, the lamp swings
shots.camera: Wide across the car, arcing

shots.action: Rook rides as a parcel too: he pops up out of a mail sack beside her with a tag tied to his hat, arms crossed, brim low (unimpressed); she laughs at him
shots.camera: Medium on Rook and May, arcing

shots.action: Close on a baby in a blanket in a mail carrier's arms, a stamp on the blanket; the carrier looks down at him (smiling) and rocks him
shots.camera: Close on the bundle, arcing

shots.action: Rook by a farm mailbox sees the carrier walk past with the baby: his beak drops, his hat hops off his head and a feather comes loose (shocked)
shots.camera: Medium on Rook, the carrier passing behind

shots.action: Dusk: the carrier walks up the lane along the white fence towards the lit farmhouse, the baby in his arms
shots.camera: Wide and low from the lane, rising

shots.action: Rook trots beside the carrier, craning over his arm at the baby, tapping his beak (soft eyes)
shots.camera: Tracking ahead of them

shots.action: The farmhouse porch: the door swings open, the grandmother throws up her hands (eyes wide, mouth open) and the carrier holds the baby out to her
shots.camera: Medium wide on the porch, arcing in

shots.action: Rook tests it: he holds a mail sack upside down and shakes it; only letters fall out; he peers into the empty sack (squinting); May laughs
shots.camera: Medium wide in the mail car, arcing

shots.action: The mail clerk crouches in front of May on her sack and does up the top of her coat (kind smile); she beams at him
shots.camera: Medium two-shot, arcing

shots.action: At the open door: May holds on and watches the hills go by (eyes wide), the clerk's hand on her shoulder, Rook beside them holding his hat on in the wind
shots.camera: Medium wide from inside the car, arcing, rocking

shots.action: Snowy morning: the clerk walks May up the path with her suitcase; the door flies open, her grandmother comes out with her arms wide (delighted) and May runs up the last step into them
shots.camera: Wide from the path, swinging round and closing in on the door

shots.action: Rook at the foot of the steps watches the hug in the doorway, touches his hat brim and turns back to us (soft eyes)
shots.camera: Medium on Rook, the doorway behind him

shots.action: An office: a bald official in a dark suit scowls, lifts a rubber stamp high and slams it down on an order; a red mark is left on the paper; the frame jolts
shots.camera: High three-quarter on the desk, swinging round and closing in

shots.action: Back in the post office: Rook reads the new notice pinned to the board, tapping his beak, then looks round at us with his brim low
shots.camera: Over the room towards the board, arcing

shots.action: The same counter a year on: a mother pushes a small boy with a stamped tag on his coat up to it (he grins); the clerk glances at the notice on the wall, back at the boy, and shrugs
shots.camera: From the far end of the counter, arcing

shots.action: Rook, elbow on the counter, watches the clerk stamp the boy's tag, throws his head back and caws with laughter
shots.camera: Medium on Rook, the stamping behind him

shots.action: Rook alone by the empty scale: he lifts a small brass weight off its shelf, turns it so it glints, pockets it and tugs his brim: 'Case closed.'
shots.camera: Medium on Rook, arcing

shots.action: Back at the scale, a moment earlier: May stands on the platform with her stamps on, looking off to the side; the camera closes in from across the room to the opening frame
shots.camera: From across the post office, closing in to the opening framing
